purpose: Document city-local registry evidence and schema-first anonymous public geometry review.
assessment: The City of Winnipeg publishes an official “Assessment Parcels” dataset maintained by Assessment and Taxation. Its public property map separately labels current assessment parcels (with roll numbers) and survey-parcel lines, and warns the map is reference-only rather than a land survey. The bounded open-data response verified two complete assessment-parcel MultiPolygons within 100 m of the WUP point using only native GISID plus geometry. This verifies the assessment-parcel GIS layer only; it does not establish legal survey or title identity. Official City property-map documentation distinguishes current assessment parcels from survey parcel lines and warns it is not survey/legal evidence. The official open-data metadata describes the Assessment Parcels dataset and includes GISID and MultiPolygon geometry alongside roll, address, assessment and property fields. The exact-point query returned zero features; a 100 m circle returned two complete MultiPolygons using only GISID and geometry.

technicalBlocker: The public dataset is an assessment parcel layer, not a title register or certified survey. Its schema also contains roll number, addresses, and assessment attributes, which were excluded from all feature requests and retained artifacts.

schemaReview.schemaNote: The open dataset has sensitive-to-location/property attributes, so feature requests used $select=gisid,geometry. The City map distinguishes assessment parcels and survey parcel lines; no legal survey status is inferred.
